answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks by binding each agent identity to a remotely verified enclave measurement, such as Intel SGX MRENCLAVE, with AMD SEV attestation providing an analogous hardware-rooted claim. Cloning an identity therefore cannot be achieved through VM duplication; an attacker must acquire and attest additional physical silicon and provisioning keys. A vine, comet, or pulse of virtual copies gains no extra voting power.
